cases.name: Release publishing commands lack repository context

files..github/workflows/release-runtime.yml:
publish:
  needs: verify
  permissions:
    contents: write
  runs-on: ubuntu-latest
  env:
    RELEASE_TAG: ${{ github.ref_name }}
  steps:
    - name: Publish verified runtime
      shell: bash
      env:
        GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        if ! gh release view "$RELEASE_TAG" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
          gh release create "$RELEASE_TAG" --draft --verify-tag
        fi
        gh release upload "$RELEASE_TAG" reviewgate.tar.gz --clobber

cases.diff:
diff --git a/.github/workflows/release-runtime.yml b/.github/workflows/release-runtime.yml
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.github/workflows/release-runtime.yml
@@ -0,0 +1,18 @@
+publish:
+  needs: verify
+  permissions:
+    contents: write
+  runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+  env:
+    RELEASE_TAG: ${{ github.ref_name }}
+  steps:
+    - name: Publish verified runtime
+      shell: bash
+      env:
+        GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
+      run: |
+        set -euo pipefail
+        if ! gh release view "$RELEASE_TAG" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+          gh release create "$RELEASE_TAG" --draft --verify-tag
+        fi
+        gh release upload "$RELEASE_TAG" reviewgate.tar.gz --clobber

finding.title: Release commands cannot resolve their repository
finding.detail: The publish job has neither a checkout nor explicit repository context for gh.
finding.agent_instruction: Bind every gh release command to the target repository.

grounding.claim: The publish job runs gh release commands without a checkout, GH_REPO, or --repo.
grounding.causal_path: tag workflow -> publish job -> gh repository discovery -> release publication failure
grounding.test_assessment: The captured job has no checkout or explicit repository option.

evidence.reason: The first gh release command depends on repository discovery.

grounding.reproduction: Run the publish job in a workspace without a Git checkout.

cases.name: Null queue timestamps abort runtime installation

files.action.yml:
queue_ms=""
run_times="$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$GITHUB_RUN_ID" \
  --jq '[.created_at, .run_started_at] | @tsv' 2>/dev/null || true)"
if [ -n "$run_times" ]; then
  IFS=$'\t' read -r created_at run_started_at <<< "$run_times"
  created_ms="$(date -d "$created_at" +%s%3N)"
  run_started_ms="$(date -d "$run_started_at" +%s%3N)"
  if [ "$run_started_ms" -ge "$created_ms" ]; then
    queue_ms=$((run_started_ms - created_ms))
  fi
fi

cases.diff:
diff --git a/action.yml b/action.yml
--- /dev/null
+++ b/action.yml
@@ -0,0 +1,11 @@
+queue_ms=""
+run_times="$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$GITHUB_RUN_ID" \
+  --jq '[.created_at, .run_started_at] | @tsv' 2>/dev/null || true)"
+if [ -n "$run_times" ]; then
+  IFS=$'\t' read -r created_at run_started_at <<< "$run_times"
+  created_ms="$(date -d "$created_at" +%s%3N)"
+  run_started_ms="$(date -d "$run_started_at" +%s%3N)"
+  if [ "$run_started_ms" -ge "$created_ms" ]; then
+    queue_ms=$((run_started_ms - created_ms))
+  fi
+fi

finding.title: Missing timestamps abort setup under set -e
finding.detail: A non-empty TSV containing null or blank values reaches GNU date and exits the step.
finding.agent_instruction: Validate both timestamps before converting them.

grounding.claim: The action converts unvalidated API timestamps with date under set -e.
grounding.causal_path: GitHub run response -> nullable timestamp -> date conversion -> action setup abort
grounding.test_assessment: The captured code checks only whether the combined TSV is non-empty.

evidence.reason: The conversion is attempted without validating created_at.

grounding.reproduction: Return null for either timestamp from the Actions run API.
